title: Brake Fluid Exchanger 98060 – Pure Brake Basic
lead: MOC has developed a new Brake Fluid Exchanger Machine that is now available for purchase.
body: This machine does not include the Standard Brake Adapter Kit. If adapters are needed, they can be purchased separately.
benefits: User Adjustable Pressure from 0-50 PSI / 3.5 BAR
Pressure gauge reads in dual scale PSI/BAR
Auto safety shutoff when new fluid is low
Auxiliary tank available (Part No. 98033) to allow the use of the 32oz bottles
